# Lipi — Indic Voice Editor

> Speak or type across 12 Indic languages 100% client-side with Swanada Conformer-CTC STT and Udgam Labs' Paar neural translation.

## What this app does
Lipi is an in-browser Indic voice and text editor supporting 12 Indian languages: Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Gujarati, Urdu, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia, and Assamese. Speech-to-text runs locally in WebAssembly via **Swanada** (`gnumanth/swanada`, capability-routed `25.35 MiB` Mobile Conformer-Small and `177.4 MiB` Studio Conformer-Large with `+EN` code-switching), and English-to-Indic translation runs locally via **Udgam Labs' Paar** (`17.7 MB` int8 ONNX models on Transformers.js).

## Links
- [Lipi App](https://h3manth.com/ai/lipi/): The live web application
- [Swanada STT](https://h3manth.com/ai/swanada/): In-browser 16 kHz multilingual Conformer-CTC speech-to-text
- [Paar Models](https://udgamlabs.com/models/paar): Udgam Labs English-to-Indic neural translation models
- [Transformers.js](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers.js): In-browser ONNX inference runtime
- [Source Code](https://github.com/hemanth/lipi): GitHub repository
- [Author](https://h3manth.com): Hemanth HM

## Features
- 12 Indic languages: Hindi (`लिपि`), Bengali (`লিপি`), Marathi (`लिपी`), Telugu (`లిపి`), Tamil (`லிபி`), Gujarati (`લિપિ`), Urdu (`لپی`, RTL Nastaliq), Kannada (`ಲಿಪಿ`), Malayalam (`ലിപി`), Punjabi (`ਲਿਪੀ`), Odia (`ଲିପି`), and Assamese (`লিপি`)
- 100% client-side neural STT via Swanada (`0.009x–0.021x` RTF, `+EN` code-switching, works in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Brave, Edge)
- On-demand English-to-Indic voice and text translation powered by Udgam Labs Paar models in-browser
- Phonetic English-to-Kannada typing helper (`ಕ` toggle)
- Full BiDi text editor with voice punctuation commands, auto-save to `localStorage`, clipboard copy, and `.txt` export

## Tech stack
- Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (zero frontend framework)
- Swanada (`gnumanth/swanada`) 16 kHz AudioWorklet + ONNX Runtime Web WASM SIMD Conformer-CTC
- Hugging Face Transformers.js (`@huggingface/transformers@3`) running quantized `q8` Paar ONNX models in a Web Worker
